title: autotrade — discovery on upbit minute bars (24h market)
_why: Crypto trades around the clock, so this runs today rather than waiting for an open — which is
the whole reason to test here first. Public candles need no key at all.
5,000 five-minute bars is about seventeen days, gathered in a few seconds by paging the
exchange's own cursor. Two hundred bars — one call — would be sixteen hours, which is not a
Costs are the venue's, not the default. Upbit charges 0.05% each way and there is no
transaction tax; the stock defaults would have charged 0.18% tax per sell and buried every
candidate. The opposite mistake is worse and was measured live on this data: the same five
5-minute BTC trades were 60% winners and +0.11% at zero cost, and 0% winners and -0.59% once
the exchange's own fee was applied. Adoption refuses a costless measurement for that reason.
Two things do not exist here that exist at a stock broker: there is no mock account, so the
ladder's middle rung is the exchange's order validator rather than a paper account; and there
is no saved screening condition, though `screen` ranks by 24-hour turnover in its place.

pipeline.instruction:
You are choosing where to search for a scalping rule on 5-minute crypto bars — a position held minutes to hours. Answer with a JSON object only, no prose.

Shape:
{"families":[...],"fast":[...],"slow":[...],"low":[...],"high":[...],"stopLossPct":[...],"takeProfitPct":[...],"feeRate":0.0005,"taxRate":0,"slippageRate":0.0002,"holdout":0.3}

families is any of: ma-cross, ema-cross, rsi, bollinger, macd. Keep feeRate, taxRate and slippageRate exactly as shown — they are this venue's real costs, 0.05% each way with no transaction tax, and a search that leaves them out measures a market where trading is free.

A round trip therefore costs about 0.14%. A take-profit under that cannot make money however often it hits, so do not propose one. Periods are counted in 5-minute bars. Read the history of refusals: a combination refused for too few trades will be refused again at the same parameters, and faster periods trade more. Keep the space under about 150 combinations.

_note: dryrun, and it should stay there until a record exists. Upbit has no paper account: mock
sends the order to the validator, and real is real money.
The screen excludes pairs the exchange has flagged — a turnover ranking finds those first,
since one of the caution flags is trading volume soaring.
